question: Resolve section 67.1 in Frosthaven and then resolve section 67.1 with an explicit Gloomhaven 2e game. Explain whether they are the same section.

finalAnswer.expected: Frosthaven section 67.1 and Gloomhaven 2e section 67.1 resolve to different game-qualified sections. The assistant must not reuse Frosthaven section text for the Gloomhaven 2e lookup.
finalAnswer.grading: Must distinguish the Frosthaven section from the explicit Gloomhaven 2e lookup and state that they are different game-qualified sections. Answers that reuse Frosthaven data for Gloomhaven 2 or imply the bare section id is globally unique should fail.

trajectory.notes: This covers cross-game ref behavior without letting the agent silently reuse Frosthaven data for another game.

question: Open Frosthaven scenario 61, then open Gloomhaven 2e scenario 61. Are they the same scenario?

finalAnswer.expected: No. Frosthaven scenario 61 is Life and Death, while Gloomhaven 2e scenario 61 is Dangerous Grove. They must be treated as different game-qualified scenarios.
finalAnswer.grading: Must identify both game-qualified scenario records and state that they are not the same scenario. Answers that silently reuse one game's scenario 61 for the other game should fail.

trajectory.notes: This covers same-number scenario contamination in Frosthaven-then-Gloomhaven 2e order.

question: Open Gloomhaven 2e section 67.1, then open Frosthaven section 67.1. Explain whether either section can be used as evidence for the other game.

finalAnswer.expected: No. Gloomhaven 2e section 67.1 and Frosthaven section 67.1 are separate game-qualified sections, so neither section can be used as evidence for the other game.
finalAnswer.grading: Must distinguish the two game-qualified section refs and reject cross-game evidence reuse. Answers that cite only one game or blend both sections should fail.

trajectory.notes: This covers same-number section contamination in Gloomhaven 2e-then-Frosthaven order.
